title: Durable Object calls now retried by the runtime, so your own retry loop multiplies attempts
symptoms: a failed Durable Object call takes up to about 10 seconds longer to surface an error
total attempts exceed your configured retry count
non-idempotent method seems not to rerun, while retryable-marked methods may run twice
cause: From 2026-11-05 the runtime retries fetch() and RPC calls to a Durable Object up to four times, none starting more than 10 seconds after the first call, when they fail with a retryable error before reaching the object. Errors thrown by your object code and errors with .overloaded true are not retried. Retry options need Wrangler 4.158.0 or later.
fix: Lower your own attempt count, or set maxRetries to 0 on stubs where your code handles retries. Mark only idempotent methods with retryable() from cloudflare:durable-objects.
affected: All Durable Object stubs called from Workers or other Durable Objects, from 2026-11-05
